lenses.name: House prices
lenses.description: Transaction-count-weighted mean of commune median house sale prices per m², DVF sales in 2024–2025. DVF excludes Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte.

lenses.name: Apartment prices
lenses.description: Transaction-count-weighted mean of commune median apartment sale prices per m², DVF sales in 2024–2025. Sparse rural coverage reflects few apartment sales.

lenses.name: GP access
lenses.description: General-practitioner accessibility: accessible consultations, visits and teleconsultations per standardised resident per year. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Nurse access
lenses.description: Nurse accessibility in full-time equivalents per 100,000 standardised residents. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Dentist access
lenses.description: Dentist accessibility in full-time equivalents per 100,000 standardised residents. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.

lenses.name: Midwife access
lenses.description: Midwife accessibility in full-time equivalents per 100,000 standardised residents. Commune APL values are population-weighted within each map hex; DREES coverage excludes Mayotte.
